name: ID Spoofing - Unknown ID on Airbag ECU
description: Attacker ECU injects traffic on 0x0D2 (airbag - safety-critical) which is not in the allowlist. Base rule UNKNOWN_ID = MEDIUM, but the safety-critical escalation raises it to HIGH. Contrast event on non-critical 0x123 stays MEDIUM.

events.reason: CAN ID 0x0D2 not in allowlist (airbag status)
